### Welcome to my website!

<hr>

I am a PhD candidate in Political Science at [*Tulane University*](https://liberalarts.tulane.edu/political-science). I hold an MS in Politics and Public Policy from Sciences Po in Paris, France, where I studied as a Mastercard Foundation Scholar. I also hold an MA in Political Science from Tulane University and a BS in Political Science from the University of Ibadan, Nigeria. My research addresses questions at the intersection of politics and public policy. My dissertation project studies corruption trials of political elites, focusing on how political and institutional contexts shape the outcomes of these cases and the prospects for holding powerful individuals accountable. My broader research interests include comparative politics, political economy, and public policy, with a focus on developing countries. My works have been published in peer-reviewed journals including [*Policy & Internet*](https://doi.org/10.1002/poi3.416), and [*Protest*](https://brill.com/view/journals/prot/4/1/article-p5_002.xml).
